nodes.label: /graphify User Command
nodes.rationale: Trigger to load the installed graphify skill or instructions before doing anything else, so all codebase exploration goes through the graph first.

nodes.label: Graphify Knowledge Graph (graphify-out)
nodes.rationale: Project maintains a knowledge graph with god nodes, community structure, and cross-file relationships to answer codebase questions faster than raw grep or source reads.

nodes.label: graphify query / path / explain Commands
nodes.rationale: Scoped subgraph retrieval (query for questions, path for relationships, explain for concepts) that returns far smaller output than GRAPH_REPORT.md or raw grep, and must run before any grep/search/source read when graph.json exists.

nodes.label: graphify update Command
nodes.rationale: Keeps the knowledge graph current after code modifications; AST-only rebuild with no API cost, so there is no reason to skip it.

nodes.label: graphify-out/graph.json
nodes.rationale: Committed graph file rewritten whole on every build; large diffs to it in a pull request are expected and should not be flagged as churn.

nodes.label: graphify-out/GRAPH_REPORT.md
nodes.rationale: Broad architecture report to read only when query/path/explain do not surface enough context, since it is much larger than a scoped subgraph.

nodes.label: graphify-out/wiki/index.md
nodes.rationale: Broad navigation entry point that should be preferred over raw source browsing when it exists.
